title: What is Extended Thinking?

body.text: Extended Thinking is a mode that lets Claude
think deeply before answering, like a thinker who reflects before speaking
— great for complex problems, multi-faceted analysis, or tasks that need high accuracy.

example: "Analyze the pros and cons of investing in an index fund vs real estate in Thailand over 10 years"

title: When to turn on Extended Thinking

body.text: Use Extended Thinking when you want
a more correct answer over a faster one
— like business planning, data analysis, or important decisions, not for simple everyday questions.

example: "Design a database for a hotel booking app supporting 100,000 users, with the trade-offs of each option"
